testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a zoom window after its first corner: tmp/obk-zoom-48987af/features/application/viewport-zoom/viewport-zoom.feature:89:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a zoom window after its first corner ✔ Given a rectangular block is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its visible planar face occupies most of the viewport ✔ When the user chooses Zoom Window from the navigation bar Zoom menu ✔ And the user clicks a first corner within the face ✔ And the user presses Escape before choosing the opposite corner ✔ Then the status area displays Ready ✔ And the face retains its previous apparent size and position ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active
